1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game with enhanced graphics
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   // ----- audio setup -----
5:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6:   let thrustOsc = null;
7:   function playThrust(start) {
8:     if (start) {
9:       if (thrustOsc) return;
10:       thrustOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:       const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:       thrustOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, audioCtx.currentTime);
13:       gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:       thrustOsc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:       thrustOsc.start();
16:     } else {
17:       if (thrustOsc) {
18:         thrustOsc.stop();
19:         thrustOsc.disconnect();
20:         thrustOsc = null;
21:       }
22:     }
23:   }
24:   function playShoot() {
25:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
26:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
27:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, audioCtx.currentTime);
28:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
29:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
30:     osc.start();
31:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
32:   }
33:   function playExplosion() {
34:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
35:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
36:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(100, audioCtx.currentTime);
37:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, audioCtx.currentTime);
38:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
39:     osc.start();
40:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.2);
41:   }
42:   function playFuel() {
43:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
44:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
45:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(800, audioCtx.currentTime);
46:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
47:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
48:     osc.start();
49:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
50:   }
51:   function playGameOver() {
52:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
53:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
54:     osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(50, audioCtx.currentTime);
55:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, audioCtx.currentTime);
56:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
57:     osc.start();
58:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 1);
59:   }
60: 
61:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
62:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
63:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
64:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
65:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
66: 
67:   // ---- starfield background ----
68:   const stars = [];
69:   for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
70:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
71:   }
72: 
73:   // ---------- game objects ----------
74:   const ship = {
75:     x: width / 2,
76:     y: height / 2,
77:     angle: 0,
78:     vx: 0,
79:     vy: 0,
80:     radius: 10,
81:     fuel: 100,
82:   };
83: 
84:   const bullets = [];
85:   const asteroids = [];
86:   const fuels = [];
87: 
88:   // ---------- helper functions ----------
89:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
90:   const distance = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
91: 
92:   function spawnAsteroid() {
93:     const edge = Math.floor(rand(0, 4));
94:     const pos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
95:     switch (edge) {
96:       case 0: pos.x = 0; pos.y = rand(0, height); break; // left
97:       case 1: pos.x = width; pos.y = rand(0, height); break; // right
98:       case 2: pos.x = rand(0, width); pos.y = 0; break; // top
99:       case 3: pos.x = rand(0, width); pos.y = height; break; // bottom
100:     }
101:     const speed = rand(0.5, 2);
102:     const angle = Math.atan2(ship.y - pos.y, ship.x - pos.x);
103:     asteroids.push({ x: pos.x, y: pos.y, vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed, r: rand(15, 30) });
104:   }
105: 
106:   function spawnFuel() {
107:     fuels.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: rand(0, height), r: 8, value: 30 });
108:   }
109: 
110:   // ---------- input ----------
111:   const keys = {};
112:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
113:     // resume audio context on first interaction
114:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
115:     keys[e.code] = true;
116:     if (e.code === 'Space') playShoot();
117:   });
118:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
119:     keys[e.code] = false;
120:     if (e.code === 'ArrowUp') playThrust(false);
121:   });
122: 
123:   // ---------- game loop ----------
124:   let last = performance.now();
125:   let asteroidTimer = 0;
126:   let fuelTimer = 0;
127:   let gameOver = false;
128:   let startTime = performance.now();
129: 
130:   function update(dt) {
131:     if (gameOver) return;
132:     // ship control
133:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 3 * dt;
134:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 3 * dt;
135:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
136:       const thrust = 0.1;
137:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
138:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
139:       ship.fuel -= dt * 5; // fuel consumption
140:       playThrust(true);
141:     } else {
142:       playThrust(false);
143:     }
144:     // shoot
145:     if (keys['Space']) {
146:       if (!ship._lastShot || performance.now() - ship._lastShot > 200) {
147:         bullets.push({ x: ship.x, y: ship.y, vx: Math.cos(ship.angle) * 5, vy: Math.sin(ship.angle) * 5, ttl: 1000 });
148:         ship._lastShot = performance.now();
149:       }
150:     }
151:     // update ship position
152:     ship.x += ship.vx; ship.y += ship.vy;
153:     // wrap around edges
154:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width; if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
155:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height; if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
156:     // friction
157:     ship.vx *= 0.99; ship.vy *= 0.99;
158: 
159:     // bullets
160:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
161:       const b = bullets[i];
162:       b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy; b.ttl -= dt * 1000;
163:       if (b.ttl <= 0) { bullets.splice(i, 1); continue; }
164:     }
165: 
166:     // asteroids
167:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.x += a.vx; a.y += a.vy; });
168:     // spawn asteroids
169:     asteroidTimer += dt;
170:     if (asteroidTimer > 1.5) { spawnAsteroid(); asteroidTimer = 0; }
171: 
172:     // fuels
173:     fuelTimer += dt;
174:     if (fuelTimer > 5) { spawnFuel(); fuelTimer = 0; }
175: 
176:     // collisions
177:     // ship-asteroid
178:     let gameOverTriggered = false;
179:     for (const a of asteroids) {
180:       if (distance(ship, a) < ship.radius + a.r) {
181:         if (!gameOver) {
182:           playExplosion();
183:           playGameOver();
184:         }
185:         gameOver = true;
186:         gameOverTriggered = true;
187:       }
188:     }
189:     // bullet-asteroid
190:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
191:       const b = bullets[i];
192:       for (let j = asteroids.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
193:         const a = asteroids[j];
194:         if (distance(b, a) < a.r) {
195:           // destroy asteroid with explosion sound
196:           playExplosion();
197:           bullets.splice(i, 1);
198:           asteroids.splice(j, 1);
199:           break;
200:         }
201:       }
202:     }
203:     // ship-fuel
204:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
205:       const f = fuels[i];
206:       if (distance(ship, f) < ship.radius + f.r) {
207:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + f.value);
208:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
209:       }
210:     }
211:     // out of fuel
212:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
213:   }
214: 
215:   function draw() {
216:     // starfield background
217:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
218:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
219:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
220:     stars.forEach(s => {
221:       ctx.beginPath();
222:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
223:       ctx.fill();
224:     });
225:     // ship with thrust flame
226:     ctx.save();
227:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
228:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
229:     // thrust flame when accelerating
230:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
231:       ctx.beginPath();
232:       ctx.moveTo(-12, 0);
233:       ctx.lineTo(-22, -5);
234:       ctx.lineTo(-22, 5);
235:       ctx.closePath();
236:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
237:       ctx.fill();
238:     }
239:     ctx.beginPath();
240:     ctx.moveTo(15, 0);
241:     ctx.lineTo(-10, -8);
242:     ctx.lineTo(-10, 8);
243:     ctx.closePath();
244:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
245:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
246:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
247:     ctx.fill();
248:     ctx.stroke();
249:     ctx.restore();
250:     // fuel bar with gradient
251:     const fuelGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(10, 10, 110, 10);
252:     fuelGrad.addColorStop(0, 'red');
253:     fuelGrad.addColorStop(1, 'lime');
254:     ctx.fillStyle = fuelGrad;
255:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, ship.fuel, 5);
256:     // bullets with glow
257:     ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
258:     ctx.shadowColor = 'yellow';
259:     ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
260:     bullets.forEach(b => ctx.beginPath(), ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2), ctx.fill());
261:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
262:     // asteroids with gradient fill
263:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
264:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
265:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
266:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
267:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
268:       ctx.beginPath();
269:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
270:       ctx.fill();
271:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#555';
272:       ctx.stroke();
273:     });
274:     // fuel pickups with glow
275:     fuels.forEach(f => {
276:       ctx.save();
277:       ctx.shadowColor = 'lime';
278:       ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
279:       ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
280:       ctx.beginPath();
281:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
282:       ctx.fill();
283:       ctx.restore();
284:     });
285:     // time display
286:     const elapsed = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
287:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
288:     ctx.shadowColor = 'black';
289:     ctx.shadowBlur = 4;
290:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${elapsed}s`, width - 100, 20);
291:     ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
292:     if (gameOver) {
293:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
294:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
295:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
296:     }
297:   }
298: 
299:   function loop(now) {
300:     const dt = (now - last) / 1000;
301:     last = now;
302:     update(dt);
303:     draw();
304:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
305:   }
306:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
307: })();

(End of file - total 307 lines)
